en:
Kaede. Is there anything you wish for me
to do?
Huh? Not at the moment.
Then why are you speaking to me?
Why...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Oh, that's right! Kirumi's a maid...

<CLT=cltMIND>So she probably thinks I want her to
do something for me.
Sorry, Kirumi...for giving you the wrong idea.

I just wanted to have a chat with you. You know,
without any of that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL> stuff.

Have a chat...with me? Of course, I do not
mind such requests.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's not a request, but more like... Well, I
don't wanna make this more complicated.

To be quite frank...I wished to speak to you
as well, Kaede.
Really? That's unexpected.
Is it?

Yeah, we don't have much in common... Oh, but
I'm happy to talk anyway! Ask me anything!

Thank you. I have prepared some questions
I would like you to answer.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi took out a notebook...
These questions all concern food.

Do you have any food allergies I should be
aware of?
Ummm... No, I don't have any.
Are there specific foods that you detest?

I can't think of any foods that I really like
or really hate.

I see, most impressive. Then I shall move on
to my next question...

Do you have a preference for certain
bedding materials?
Bedding materials?

For example, do you prefer down, buckwheat,
memory foam, or cotton pillows?

Ummm... The pillow I have right now is
good enough...
What are you planning?
Are you doing research?
Pillows are important
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltMIND>Why is she asking this? Is this some kind
of interrogation?
What are you planning?
Planning?
<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi gave me a confused look.

I am not planning anything.
You have quite an imagination, Kaede.
<CLT=cltMIND>Sh-She laughed at me!
<CLT=cltMIND>It's pretty rare to see Kirumi laugh.
Are you doing research?

Oh, my apologies. Are my questions causing
you discomfort?
No, I did say you could ask me anything, but...

Ah, I should have been forthright with my
intentions.
Pillows are important.

Yes, a proper pillow will not only ensure a good
night's rest, but prevent maladies as well.

The pillows in the dormitory rooms seem
adequate, I suppose...

But I would prefer that everyone had their
own custom pillow.

I understand, but...why are you so concerned
about that?
Why wouldn't I be concerned?

Your comfort matters very much to me, Kaede.
Hence, my questions.

With the information you have provided,
I can provide you with greater service.
What!? You'd do all that for me?

Not just for you, but for everyone else
as well.

Once we are finished here, I intend to
present these questions to the others.
<CLT=cltMIND>Oh, that's why she wanted to talk to me...

If you are not content for any reason, please
call for me and I shall fulfill any request.
O-Okay, thanks.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi sure loves to take care of people...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kirumi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Kirumi, I returned
to my room.
